pointsOfInterest.name: Greywell Spaceport
pointsOfInterest.description: A wretched hive of scum and villainy. The main spaceport on Gravenmoor, filled with cantinas, markets, and all manner of shady characters.

pointsOfInterest.name: Vorga's Palace
pointsOfInterest.description: The former stronghold of Vorga the Vorr. Now abandoned but still dangerous, filled with traps and potential treasure.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Marn Homestead
pointsOfInterest.description: The abandoned moisture farm where Dav Marn grew up. A place of historical significance, now empty but holding secrets.

pointsOfInterest.name: Beggar's Canyon
pointsOfInterest.description: A treacherous canyon system where legendary swoop bike races are held. Home to dangerous creatures and hidden dangers.

pointsOfInterest.name: Sunder Wastes
pointsOfInterest.description: The vast desert wasteland of Gravenmoor, home to wyrm dragons, Dune Nomads, and other dangers.

pointsOfInterest.name: Greywell Cantina
pointsOfInterest.description: The famous cantina where deals are made and information is traded. A hub for smugglers and bounty hunters.
